result.description: FINTRAC-registered forensic FX audit engine that detects hidden bank spreads vs mid-market rates on currency transactions, via REST API, webhooks and MCP server.
result.auth_detail: API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_...` (production) or `ipx_test_...` (sandbox). Keys are server-side, generated in the dashboard. Webhooks signed HMAC-SHA256 (x-ipayx-signature). No OAuth.
result.access_detail: Self-serve signup at ipayx.ai/auth, key generated in dashboard. Free tier is tiny (3 lifetime audits on pricing page; MCP docs say 10 audits/day per key). Credit Pack $99 for 100 audits, Unlimited $299/mo. Developers page lists API plans from $99/mo (100 audits, sandbox) up to Enterprise $100K/yr. Pages conflict on free limits and prices, so exact gating is unclear.
result.api_notes: docs/api lists 3 endpoints (POST /audit, GET /rates, POST /audit/document) plus an audit.completed webhook. Developers page lists POST /v1/audit and GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/score-config. Base is a Supabase edge function URL; api.ipayx.ai is "coming soon". Docs conflict between pages. The /docs root returns 404. The REST surface is a handful of endpoints.
result.blocker: Narrow API (about 3-6 endpoints), tiny free quota, and inconsistent docs (endpoints, prices, MCP URL differ across pages). Self-serve keys exist, so buildable but low value.
